text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Good. That's a nice time. My accuracy has improved a great deal too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I think it's about time for a break. Whether it's talking or running, we have to make sure we have enough energy for it.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: …Hm? This is the cafeteria, isn't it? Why does it look so different?
choice_data_list: Maybe they've decorated for the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha! That's right. I didn't even realize it was that time of year already!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: It looks like they're serving roast chicken and seasonal cake. Ooh! Look, they have pizza over there too!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I don't see any curry, but I suppose that makes sense, hehe.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Um, I know it's not exactly a traditional dish for this time of year…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But at my house, we always used to make what everyone liked for our holiday dinner.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'd ask my mom to make a fruitcake for me, and Brian would ask me to make curry for her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course, she'd always ask at the last minute, but the thing is, it takes hours to stew the vegetables for her favorite kind of curry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I remember correctly, the Arima Kinen falls on a rather special holiday this year.
choice_data_list: What kind of present are you going to give Brian?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha. Well, let's see… I suppose I'll give her the best race ever.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I want to face her in the Twinkle Series and run against her in perfect form.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And I'll prevail with my winning equation.
choice_data_list: You can't let her win, huh?
You can't let her win, huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Of course not. I have my pride to preserve as her older sister.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: By the way… what are your favorite foods?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's make the most of today and eat our favorites!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide and I have a wonderfully cheerful meal together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: There's so much snow all around. It really makes for the perfect festive atmosphere.
choice_data_list: You're even dressed kind of like Santa.
You're even dressed kind of like Santa.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haha, you're right. I fit right in, don't I?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Now then, Trainer, tell Santa what you wish for this year. I might just bring it to you!
choice_data_list: I wish for you to win!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Very well. You'll get your wish soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles confidently at me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide and I have a wonderfully cheerful meal together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: So… Why did you bring me here again?
choice_data_list: I thought maybe you'd like a fruitcake.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You should think about yourself once in a while too. You're far too indulgent with me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Let's get two cakes and take them home. One for me, and one for you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide and I each get a cake and enjoy them together.
